source.original_question:
In triangle ABC above, the bisector of angle BAC is AD. The length of AB is equal to the length of AC. What is the measure of angle BAC?
Choices:
A.15*\degree
B.30*\degree
C.45*\degree
D.60*\degree
E.75*\degree

Choices:
A.15*\degree
B.30*\degree
C.45*\degree
D.60*\degree
E.75*\degree
audit.independent_solution: In right triangle ABD, sin BAD=BD/AB=3/6=1/2, so BAD=30 degrees. AD bisects BAC, hence BAC=60 degrees.
